source.title: Getting the most out of Opus 5.5 in Claude and Claude Code
source.author: saikatsg

title.en: Opus 5.5: Claude and Claude Code Guide

excerpt.zh: Opus 5.5更适合长流程任务：明确完成标准、减少冗余思考提示，并用文件清单、结果审查和人工确认控制风险，同时注意安全拦截与模型切换。
excerpt.en: Opus 5.5 supports longer Claude and Claude Code tasks when prompts define completion, checkpoints, review, and limits around safety flags.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Opus 5.5的核心变化，是更适合独立推进长时间、多步骤的工作。Claude官方指南建议，用户在一条消息中说明完整任务、明确“完成”的标准，以及只有在什么情况下才需要暂停询问；例如迁移所有接口、删除旧客户端并通过测试。与其反复要求模型“认真思考”，不如把精力放在边界和验收条件上。
text.en: Opus 5.5 is presented as better suited to long, multi-step work that can proceed with limited supervision. Anthropic’s guide recommends putting the full task in one message, defining what “done” means, and specifying when the model should stop to ask; for example, requiring every endpoint to be migrated, the old client removed, and tests to pass. Instead of repeatedly asking it to think harder, users should focus on boundaries and acceptance criteria.

text.zh: 在Claude Code中，项目级的CLAUDE.md可以规定哪些步骤应继续执行、哪些操作必须先征得同意。指南还建议为大型审计、迁移或代码检查分派子代理，并要求核对每个子代理的证据；对耗时任务，则把清单保存到TASKS.md等文件中，以免长对话被压缩后丢失进度。对于设计任务，列出明确不希望出现的视觉模式，也比笼统地说“不要普通”更有效。
text.en: In Claude Code, a project-level CLAUDE.md file can state which steps should continue and which actions require approval. The guide also recommends assigning large audits, migrations, or reviews to subagents while checking each subagent’s evidence. For lengthy runs, keeping a checklist in a file such as TASKS.md makes progress easier to recover after older conversation turns are summarized. For design work, naming specific unwanted patterns is more useful than simply asking for something “non-generic.”
Build review into the Opus 5.5 workflow

text.zh: 长任务结束后，应先查看模型还需要用户决定什么，再阅读完整总结。指南称，Opus 5.5会更清楚地说明已完成的工作、发现的问题和待处理事项；用户还可以要求它只报告足以阻止合并的问题，提供文件与行号，并标记无法确认的内容。Claude应用中，直接上传图表、截图或演示文稿，通常比重新输入其中的数据更适合检查空间关系、日期、数字和名称的一致性。
text.en: When a long task ends, users should first check what decisions or approvals Claude still needs, then read the full summary. The guide says Opus 5.5 reports completed work, findings, and open needs more clearly; users can also ask it to list only merge-blocking issues, include files and lines, and mark anything it could not confirm. In Claude apps, uploading the actual chart, screenshot, or deck is preferable to retyping data when checking spatial relationships and consistency in dates, numbers, or names.

text.zh: 安全拦截仍是重要限制
text.en: Safety flags remain an important limitation

text.zh: 这套工作方式并不意味着可以取消人工监督。指南说明，Opus 5.5采用更严格的生物与网络安全防护；被标记的消息在Claude应用和Claude Code中通常会切换到较旧模型，且触发原因可能来自对话中的文件或搜索结果，而不只是最后一条消息。合法的安全研究有时仍可能被误判，用户可以切回Opus 5.5、修改上一条消息或提交反馈。指南同时明确建议不要要求模型展示内部推理，而应要求可核查的结论、证据和不确定性。
text.en: This workflow does not remove the need for human oversight. The guide says Opus 5.5 launches with stronger biosecurity and cybersecurity safeguards; when a message is flagged, Claude apps and Claude Code generally switch to an older model, and the trigger may come from files or search results in the conversation rather than only the latest message. Legitimate security work can still be flagged incorrectly, so users may switch back, edit the last message, or submit feedback. The guide also advises against requesting hidden reasoning, favoring verifiable conclusions, evidence, and uncertainty instead.
